goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Fixed precise-modifier capture for svg.js selection bounding shapes by resolving .svg_select_shape and .svg_select_shape_pointSelect to the current selected object. Meta-drag on the overlay is now intercepted before mutation, while ordinary overlay drag and Meta-modified resize/rotation handles remain available. Added a behavioral regression reproducing the browser coordinates and overlay mutation path, with clean serialization and history assertions. Typecheck, all 165 targeted tests, and production build pass.
